column2: Portfolio / Data Analysis / Power BI practice dataset
107 real human gene records derived from NCBI Gene data already included in the source workbook.
1,000 observation rows built from those 107 genes.

Sample_ID, Tissue, Condition, Expression_Level, Expression_Log2, Fold_Change, Significance_PValue and Expression_Category are simulated for analytical practice; they are NOT real patient or biological measurements.
NCBI Datasets supports downloading gene metadata for all human genes with 'datasets summary gene taxon human' and gene packages with 'datasets download gene taxon human'.
Build a Power BI dashboard: gene count, expression by tissue, treatment vs control, top genes by fold change, p-value distribution, chromosome/gene-type analysis.
Do not interpret the simulated expression values as medical or biological findings.
